title: Q3 2026 Nickel Price Review
gist: Nickel prices reversed Q2 strength in Q3 2026: sulphate (EXW China) fell 13% to RMB 28,500/t, CIF Asia MHP 17.3% and EXW Europe metal 9.5%, as LFP displaced NCM demand, DRC cobalt exports resumed, and Indonesian cost pressures eased via mid-year RKAB quotas, a revised HPM ore formula and better sulphur supply. Q4 risks include Hormuz disruption and El Niño droughts potentially hitting 30-40% of Indonesian supply.

insights.claim: Nickel sulphate prices (EXW China) fell 13% from end-Q2 to RMB 28,500/tonne ($4,247) as of 23 September 2026.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Battery-grade nickel has given back Q2 gains, pressuring refiners' margins.

insights.claim: Over Q3 2026, aggregate CIF Asia MHP prices declined 17.3% while EXW Europe nickel metal prices fell 9.5%.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Intermediates fell faster than metal, compressing upstream Indonesian HPAL realisations.

insights.claim: Benchmark's senior analyst attributes weak Q3 nickel prices to easing cost pressures at Indonesian refiners and smelters, fresh production quotas and weakening nickel-based cathode demand.
insights.speaker: Frederick Bloomfield
insights.so_what: Supply-side relief and demand weakness coincided, removing H1's price support.
insights.quote: Easing cost pressures at Indonesian refiners and smelters, alongside fresh production quotas and weakening nickel-based cathode demand

insights.claim: Nickel sulphate prices eased on softening demand, lower raw material prices and undercutting by recycled material, with thin liquidity leading Chinese suppliers to lower offers to offload material.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Recycled nickel is now a competitive source that caps sulphate prices.
insights.locator: Q3 reversed the strength of Q2

insights.claim: CIF Asia nickel sulphate premiums over the LME stayed stable at $1,700-1,750/tonne throughout Q3 2026 because most material was delivered under contract.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Seaborne premiums are sticky, so the spot weakness is concentrated in China.

insights.claim: LME nickel metal prices retreated through Q3 as investors responded to softening Indonesian supply restrictions and mounting visible inventories on the LME and SHFE.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Rising exchange stocks are a bearish signal for nickel futures.
insights.quote: mounting visible inventories on the LME and SHFE exchanges
insights.locator: LME nickel metal prices also retreated

insights.claim: Nickel demand underwhelmed in Q3 2026 as EV sales underperformed expectations and the market kept shifting from nickel-based cathodes to the increasingly dominant LFP.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Structural chemistry shift to LFP erodes long-run nickel battery demand.
insights.quote: the market continued to shift from nickel-based cathode chemistries to the increasingly dominant LFP
insights.locator: Demand underwhelmed in Q3 as EV

insights.claim: CATL curtailed NCM cell production and NCM cathode active material orders towards the end of Q3 2026.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: The largest cell maker cutting NCM is a strong negative signal for nickel and cobalt chemicals.
insights.quote: major players like CATL curtailing NCM cell production and NCM CAM orders
insights.locator: Demand underwhelmed in Q3 as EV

insights.claim: Precursor and cathode producers relied primarily on long-term contract volumes and internal stockpiles, keeping spot nickel sulphate liquidity thin.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Thin spot markets amplify price moves and weaken price discovery.
insights.locator: Demand underwhelmed in Q3 as EV

insights.claim: Potential NCM demand recovery is a key variable shaping nickel market conditions in Q4 2026.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Any NCM rebound would be an upside catalyst for nickel prices.

insights.claim: Resumption of DRC cobalt shipments in August reduced buying interest in Indonesian cobalt-containing MHP, leading MHP buyers to lower bids.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Cobalt by-product credits for Indonesian MHP producers are vulnerable to DRC policy.

insights.claim: Aggregate CIF Asia MHP prices fell from $9,045/tonne to $7,484/tonne over Q3 2026, partly because Ni payables slipped from 93.5% to 88.5%.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Payable compression directly cuts HPAL producer revenues.
insights.quote: from USD $9,045/tonne to $7,484/tonne, in part due to Ni Payables slipping from 93.5% to 88.5%

insights.claim: In mid-July Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources ruled out a major upward revision to the 2026 RKAB mining quota, keeping it near 260-270Mwmt versus the 300-360Mwmt some participants expected.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
entities: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
insights.so_what: Indonesia continues to cap ore supply, a structural support for nickel prices.
insights.quote: the approved range would remain close to 260–270Mwmt, rather than the 300–360Mwmt

insights.claim: Mid-year production quotas released through Q3 brought assets like Eramet and Tsingshan's Weda Bay back online, easing cost pressures and the quota-driven scarcity fears that had buoyed H1 pricing.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Quota releases removed the scarcity premium that drove H1 nickel strength.
insights.quote: mitigating some of the concerns around acute quota-driven scarcity that had buoyed H1 pricing

insights.claim: A revised Indonesian HPM ore pricing formula effective 15 September 2026 cut benchmark prices sharply for lower-grade ore, reducing feedstock costs for refiners processing lower-grade laterite.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Lower ore costs lower the nickel cost curve, reducing price floors.
insights.quote: a revised HPM ore pricing formula took effect on 15 September, cutting benchmark prices sharply for lower-grade ore

insights.claim: Improved sulphur availability as Middle East tensions cooled improved the balance sheets of Indonesian RKAB players.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: HPAL economics are sensitive to sulphur, linking nickel costs to Middle East geopolitics.

insights.claim: The extent to which the renewed HPM ore pricing formulae are adopted is a key factor for Q4 2026 nickel market conditions.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Adoption determines how far the cost curve shifts down.

insights.claim: Renewed disruption at the Strait of Hormuz in Q4 2026 would quickly reverse Q3's cost relief for Indonesian HPAL operators.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Middle East escalation is a tail-risk upside catalyst for nickel via sulphur costs.
insights.quote: risk of renewed disruption at the Strait of Hormuz, which would quickly reverse Q3's cost relief for Indonesian HPAL operators

insights.claim: Ongoing El Niño-related droughts in Indonesia are worrying HPAL and RKEF operators, with some suggesting impacts on up to 30-40% of supply.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A climate-driven supply shock could abruptly tighten the nickel market.
insights.quote: some suggesting it could impact up to 30–40% of supply

insights.claim: Benchmark is tracking the pipeline of MHP production scheduled to come online in coming months and its impact on a tight market, alongside nickel metal inventory buildup.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: New MHP capacity and rising inventories are bearish offsets to supply risks.
